# Suggestion-parity reference set (SPEC §19.4): common misspellings with the
# intended correction. Format: misspelled | intended-correct (one per line).
# Dialect-neutral spellings only (both en-US and en-GB dictionaries must be
# able to produce the intended correction).
#
# The hunspell capture run (tests/data/spelling_hunspell.txt) records
# hunspell's own top-5 for every entry below; the parity test asserts
# stoppard's top-1 >= hunspell's top-1 hit rate and >= 90%, top-5 >= 98%.
